description: Use when you need to check an email address before sending, signing up a user or adding a lead: syntax (IDN-aware), MX records with A/AAAA fallback, null MX, and disposable, role (info@, sales@). Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /v1/email/verify, $0.01 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Checks one mailbox; for a list use check_email_batch. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

email.description: email address to check, e.g. name@example.org

name: check_email_address
title: Check email address
